config.notes: AICBT, Australia International College of Business & Technology (aicbt.edu.au/our-courses/<package>-<slug>/). All 4 active courses have a hand-bound read page. Each prints 'the course fee will be all-inclusive ... Program fees are: <package code> <course name> $13,500 Other Fees Enrolment fee AU$650.00 ...' (read as fee). The figure is not labelled international and is all-inclusive, but it equals the CRICOS international tuition for all 4 courses (13,500, 13,500, 14,000, 14,000) and every course is 52 weeks, so the whole-course figure is the annual fee (lesson 3: one-year programme, use fee). The page also shows a web-shop line 'initial payment of AU$4,050, along with an enrolment fee of AU$650, resulting in a total of AU$ 4,700', which the general reader once took as the fee for 111034M; the adapter anchors on 'Program fees are:' instead. English: '(IELTS) band 6.0' is printed on 1 of 4 pages only (111033A), under the half rule, so it is read for review and held. Delivery: a face-to-face weekly timetable plus 'online delivery for offshore students' (two modes), so no mode pattern. Intakes: not printed.
